Container.Name: ironsbot
Container.Overview: IronsBot custom image for Seer information queries, NoneBot2/OneBot v11 messaging, and personal Unraid-friendly plugins. Version tags use latest plus upstream-version.fork-revision tags and exact sha tags; behavior config is file-based through APP_CONFIG_PATH, with environment variables kept for secrets, credentials, and deployment runtime only.
Container.Description: IronsBot 是一个基于 NoneBot2 和 OneBot v11 的 QQ 机器人。这个镜像面向赛尔号查询、群聊回复、B 站动态监控、活动提醒、AI 聊天和 Unraid 部署。行为配置写在 /config/ironsbot.toml，环境变量只保留 OneBot token、AI Key、米米号凭据和部署运行参数，数据缓存保存在 /app/data。超级管理员可使用 /更新数据 手动刷新 SQLite 数据。
Container.Requires: Requires a OneBot v11 client such as NapCat. Configure the client reverse WebSocket to ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws, or use ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws when both containers share a Docker network. Changelog/version check: latest remains available; fixed builds are tagged as upstream-version.fork-revision plus sha-xxxxxxx. See the Docker Hub README / ReadMe link for full notes.
Container.Changes:
Version scheme: - latest: current main branch of this fork. - upstream-version.fork-revision: current upstream IronsBot version plus this fork revision. - sha-xxxxxxx: exact Git commit used to build the image.
Recent changes: - Added DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible AI chat through bot mentions. - Added persistent Bilibili login data under /app/data. - Added startup notice, scheduled private messages, team group query shortcuts, and manual database refresh. - Switched Unraid behavior configuration to a mounted TOML file via APP_CONFIG_PATH. - Kept Unraid environment variables minimal: secrets, credentials, and deployment runtime only.

Config.Name: WebSocket Port
Config.Description: 主机端口映射到容器内 8080，NapCat/OneBot 反向 WebSocket 连接这个端口。

Config.Name: IronsBot Data
Config.Description: 持久化数据目录，用来保存插件缓存、B站 Cookie、SQLite 数据库和本地缓存文件。

Config.Name: IronsBot Config
Config.Description: 只读挂载配置目录，目录内放 ironsbot.toml。可从仓库的 config.prod.toml 或 config.example.toml 复制后修改。

Config.Name: Environment
Config.Description: NoneBot 运行环境名，生产环境通常填 prod。

Config.Name: Driver
Config.Description: NoneBot 驱动配置，保持 ~fastapi+~httpx 即可支持 OneBot 反向 WebSocket 和 HTTP 请求。

Config.Name: Host
Config.Description: 容器内监听地址，Docker/Unraid 中建议 0.0.0.0。

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: 容器内监听端口，需与端口映射的容器端口一致。

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: 日志级别，可填 TRACE、DEBUG、INFO、WARNING 或 ERROR。

Config.Name: Command Start
Config.Description: 命令前缀列表，包含空字符串时可直接发送口令。

Config.Name: App Config Path
Config.Description: 行为配置 TOML 文件路径。Unraid 中保持 /config/ironsbot.toml，并在上方 Config 目录里放置该文件。

Config.Name: OneBot Access Token
Config.Description: OneBot 连接令牌，必须和 NapCat 等 OneBot 客户端的 access_token 一致。

Config.Name: AI Chat API Key
Config.Description: AI 聊天的 API Key，例如 DeepSeek Key；这是密钥，不要提交到 Git。

Config.Name: SendPic CNB Token
Config.Description: 可选。custom_sendpic 使用 CNB 后端时的访问令牌；仓库名等行为配置写在 /config/ironsbot.toml。
